$comment: The roster under test. To benchmark a newly released model, add one entry and run:
'openai-compatible' — openai SDK + baseURL override. Covers OpenAI, OpenRouter,
Z.ai, Moonshot, DashScope, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Together.
'manual'            — no API. The runner skips it; you produce each deliverable in
the harness and drop it at runs/<id>/<benchmark>/index.html.
Scoring is identical to an API-generated run.
Models whose apiKeyEnv is unset are SKIPPED (not failed) by --all.
params are passed to the provider verbatim — per-model tuning goes there.
KEYS NEEDED FOR THIS ROSTER: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GLM_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY
(+ DASHSCOPE_API_KEY for Qwen). Every OpenRouter entry can be pointed at its vendor's
direct endpoint instead — swap baseURL + apiKeyEnv and drop the vendor/ prefix.

models.$comment: Anthropic's most capable model. Thinking is always on — the thinking parameter is omitted deliberately, since an explicit config is rejected. Requires 30-day data retention: under ZDR every request 400s. Safety classifiers can return stop_reason refusal, which the provider surfaces as a clear error.
models.label: Claude Fable 5
Claude Opus 5
models.$comment: max_tokens covers thinking AND output. 64k truncated this model mid-document at xhigh effort; 128k is its ceiling and leaves room for both.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.$comment: max_tokens covers thinking AND output. 64k truncated this model mid-document at xhigh effort; 128k is its ceiling and leaves room for both.
Haiku 4.5 predates adaptive thinking and the effort parameter. It takes the older budget_tokens form, and sending output_config.effort would 400. Max output is 64K.
models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5

models.$comment: Grok 4.6 (verified in the OpenRouter catalog 2026-08-12): 500k context, $2/$6 per MTok (rate doubles above 200k prompt tokens — irrelevant at our prompt sizes), image input supported, no published max_completion cap. max_tokens 128000 because Grok 4.5 truncated 08-accessible at the 64k ceiling in the July run — don't repeat that. Catalog lists the vendor as 'SpaceXAI'; vendor field stays 'xai' so the site groups it with Grok 4.5.
models.label: Grok 4.6

models.$comment: The raw model over xAI's API via OpenRouter. To measure the Cursor HARNESS driving Grok instead, change provider to 'manual' and run the briefs inside Cursor.
models.label: Grok 4.5

models.$comment: Composer is Cursor-only — there is no public API, so this can only be run by hand inside Cursor. Paste each brief from benchmarks/ (plus benchmarks/_contract.md) and save the result to runs/cursor-composer-2.5/<benchmark-id>/index.html.
models.label: Cursor Composer 2.5

models.$comment: Moved off the Z.ai coding-plan endpoint (https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4, model 'glm-5.2', GLM_API_KEY) to OpenRouter. GLM 5.2 spends its output budget on reasoning before emitting content, so at max_tokens 64000 it truncated or returned an EMPTY body (finish_reason: length) on the harder briefs — 01 produced 2kb after ten minutes, 10 produced nothing at all. OpenRouter publishes max_completion_tokens 131072 for this model, so 64000 was our ceiling, not the model's. Raising it to 128000 is the fix; do not lower it, which forces truncation rather than preventing it. The Z.ai route still works for lighter tasks if you want it back.
models.label: GLM 5.2

models.$comment: vision:false is a conservative default — it only affects the judge audit, which sends screenshots to every model in this roster. If DeepSeek's OpenRouter route does accept image input, flip it to true; if it does not and this is left unset, every audit call for this model 404s with 'No endpoints found that support image input' (the failure qwen3.7-max hit). Generation is unaffected either way.
models.label: DeepSeek V4 Pro

models.$comment: Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 (coding-focused update, released via Meta Model API). Verified in the OpenRouter catalog as meta/muse-spark-1.2: 1M context, image input supported (so no vision:false), $1.25/M in, $4.25/M out, no published max_completion_tokens cap. max_tokens 128000 because it reasons inside the output budget (a 'Say READY' probe burned ~270 reasoning tokens and returned an EMPTY body at max_tokens 64) — the same failure mode that truncated GLM 5.2 at 64000; do not lower it. GATE: OpenRouter 403s on this model until the account confirms 18+ age attestation at https://openrouter.ai/settings/preferences — one-time, account-level. Direct alternative: Meta Model API at https://api.meta.ai/v1 (OpenAI-compatible), model 'muse-spark-1.2', key from the Meta Developer Console — swap baseURL/apiKeyEnv/model to use it.
models.label: Muse Spark 1.2

models.$comment: Qwen3.8-Max (released Aug 2026, announced via Qoder alongside 2.4T-parameter claim — the Qoder free credits are product credits, not API credits; this entry bills OpenRouter list rates $2/$6 per MTok). Verified in the OpenRouter catalog: 1M context, max_completion_tokens 131072, image input supported so no vision:false — it can also serve in judge audits, unlike 3.7-max. max_tokens 128000 on the GLM/Muse precedent for models that reason inside the output budget; verify with the probe before lowering.
models.label: Qwen 3.8 Max

models.$comment: Verified present in the OpenRouter catalog. Superseded by qwen3.8-max (separate entry) but kept for cross-version comparison. vision:false because no OpenRouter endpoint for this model accepts image input — without it every judge-audit call 404s. Only the audit reads this flag; it does not affect generation.
models.label: Qwen 3.7 Max

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. OpenAI flagship, released 2026-09-03 (OpenRouter 09-04). Verified in catalog: 1.05M context, max_completion_tokens 128000, $10/$50 per MTok — same rate card as Fable 5, so budget ~$25 for the full twelve briefs if its verbosity is Fable-like. Supports reasoning_effort via OpenRouter. The user-facing name is just Astra.
models.label: GPT-6 Astra

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-29 (DevDay), upgrade of GPT-6 Sol (09-22) and successor to the tested GPT-5.6 Sol. $2/$10, 1.05M ctx, 128k out. GPT-6 Sol itself is skipped — superseded within a week.
models.label: GPT-6.1 Sol

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Cheap tier of GPT-6 (2026-09-22), successor to the tested GPT-5.6 Luna. $0.10/$0.50, 128k out. No GPT-6 Terra exists as of 2026-10-05 — 5.6 Terra remains the current Terra and stays as the Engineering judge.

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-01, successor to Fable 5 at the same $10/$50. Same rules as Fable 5: thinking always on, omit the thinking param, control depth with output_config.effort; 30-day retention required; may return stop_reason refusal. New in 5.1: forced tool_choice 400s (irrelevant here), thinking blocks bound to the model (irrelevant — single turn).
models.label: Claude Fable 5.1

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-22, successor to Opus 5 at $4/$20 (was $5/$25). Thinking cannot be disabled; effort DEFAULTS TO MEDIUM on this model (Opus 5 defaulted high), so xhigh is set explicitly to match the Opus 5 entry. max_tokens covers thinking + output; keep 128k.
models.label: Claude Opus 5.5

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-28, successor to Sonnet 5 at the same $2/$10. thinking disabled returns 400; adaptive is fine. Effort levels recalibrated vs Sonnet 5 but xhigh kept for parity with the Sonnet 5 entry.
models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-21, succeeds Grok 4.6. Same $2/$6, 500k ctx, 450k max completion. 128k max_tokens on the Grok 4.5 truncation precedent. Catalog vendor is SpaceXAI; vendor stays xai to group with 4.5/4.6.

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-08-14 (OpenRouter 08-18), succeeds GLM 5.2. $1.40/$4.40, 1M ctx, max_completion 131072. Text-only in the catalog, hence vision:false. 128k on the GLM 5.2 precedent (reasons inside the output budget). glm-5.3-prime (09-23) is the same model on a faster lane at 2x price — not a separate model, skipped.
models.label: GLM 5.3

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-02, succeeds the tested Muse Spark 1.2. Same $1.25/$4.25, 1M ctx, image input. Same 18+ attestation gate on OpenRouter as 1.2.
models.label: Muse Spark 1.3

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. FIRST GOOGLE MODEL ON THE ROSTER. Released 2026-09-02, $0.75/$3.75, 1M ctx. WARNING: max_completion_tokens is 65536 and this model reasons inside the output budget, so 01/08/11 may truncate — that is a finding, not a config bug; do not expect 128k. Gemini 4 Argon (announced 2026-09-30) has NO public API model ID as of 2026-10-05 (Fairwind Program only) — add it when the catalog lists it. Google has shipped no Pro-tier model since gemini-3.1-pro-preview (Feb 2026).
models.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. Released 2026-09-09 (OpenRouter 09-10). 552B MoE, new CED architecture, image input, 1M ctx, max_completion 943718. Catalog shows $0.00 input / $2.40 output on the primary route (likely promotional); the :batch route is $0.11/$0.34. DeepSeek V4.1 Pro is named but not released.

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. The GA snapshot of V4 Pro (2026-08-12), distinct from the April deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro the July run tested; priced differently ($0.85/$5.00 vs $0.21/$0.42), so treat as a new model. Text-only, vision:false.

models.$comment: ADDED 2026-10-05, untested. The 2026-09-02 snapshot of Qwen3.8 Max.
